services.name: InteractionGate_Type46_AF
services.behavior: Selector 0xAF requires 0x00FFF172 != 0 and 0x00FF7E3C != 0x39, then forward-spawns the shared type-0x46 template at 0x001B79CC.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType44_AB
services.behavior: Selector 0xAB requires 0x00FFF16F != 0, then zero-template allocates and installs runtime type 0x44, animation root 0x00122C40, and actor byte +0x29 = 1.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType44_50
services.behavior: Selector 0x50 zero-template allocates and installs runtime type 0x44, animation root 0x00122C40, and actor byte +0x29 = 1.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType5A_8E
services.behavior: Selector 0x8E loads the type-0x5A level-object template at 0x001B7A08 through LevelObjectSpawnEntry.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType5C_90
services.behavior: Selector 0x90 loads the type-0x5A template and promotes a successful allocation to type 0x5C.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType5D_91
services.behavior: Selector 0x91 loads the type-0x5A template and promotes a successful allocation to type 0x5D.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType01_87
services.behavior: Selector 0x87 reverse-spawns from the established type-0x01 template at 0x001B7A30.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType4E_BB
services.behavior: Selector 0xBB reverse-spawns the type-0x4E template at 0x001B7F80 and sets actor byte +0x09 to 0xFF on success.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType4E_A9
services.behavior: Selector 0xA9 reverse-spawns the type-0x4E template at 0x001B7F80.

services.name: InteractionSpawn_RuntimeType4F_A6
services.behavior: Selector 0xA6 reverse-spawns the type-0x4F template at 0x001B7F94.
